My Sewing Picks

Hand-picked tools & fabrics for your sewing corner.

Welcome in! I'm the maker behind SEWING DIY PATCHWORK, where I sew bags, quilts, clothes, and cozy things for the home. Everything you'll find here is something I personally recommend — gathered in one place so you can find your next favorite, too.
